Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: In `surchargeForItem` (/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_00-13-47_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking-2/src/claim-office.ts), the two `if` blocks no longer early-return. They accumulate into a local `surcharge` total which is returned.

**Result**: All tests pass (16 passing, 32 todo).

**Approach**: This is minimal — no new constants, no new abstractions, no change to the surcharge percentages or threshold. The only edit was converting two mutually exclusive early returns into additive accumulation, which is exactly what the test demands (100 base + 50 curse + 30 enchantment + 10 first insurance + 5 fee = 195). All previously passing tests remain green because an item with only one qualifying attribute still yields the same single surcharge.
